discussion: The public check failed on 4 doctest examples. The issues are: (1) My exception examples show just the exception line (e.g., 'ValueError: Port out of range 0-65535') without a full traceback, so doctest interprets them as expected stdout rather than expected exceptions. (2) The empty port case (http://example.com:/: ) apparently doesn't raise - 'Got nothing' suggests the property returned None or empty output. I need to check the actual parsing behavior for empty ports and fix the doctest format to use full tracebacks.
